description: This file defines the PHP class 'Review' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Catalog' namespace. It contains methods for managing product reviews, including adding, editing, deleting reviews, fetching review data, and calculating ratings in an OpenCart administration context.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Class providing CRUD operations and analytical methods for product reviews in the admin catalog module of OpenCart.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Inserts a new review record into the database, then updates the product's rating and clears relevant cache.

methods.name: editReview
methods.description: Updates an existing review record and refreshes product rating and cache.

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Deletes a review by its ID and updates the product's rating and cache.

methods.name: deleteReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Deletes all reviews associated with a specific product ID and clears the cache.

methods.name: getReview
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific review ID.

methods.name: getRating
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average rating for a specific product.

methods.name: getReviews
methods.description: Fetches a list of reviews with optional filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReviews
methods.description: Returns the total count of reviews matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalReviewsAwaitingApproval
methods.description: Returns the count of reviews pending approval (status = 0).
